hook: Ye Prompt Try Karo, Fark Dekho

points.title: Role do
points.text: Likho: Tum ek expert teacher ho. AI usi andaaz mein jawab dega.

points.title: Context batao
points.text: Kis liye chahiye, kiske liye hai, kitna aata hai, sab batao.

points.title: Format maango
points.text: Bolo: 5 points mein, table mein, ya 100 words mein. Jawab saaf milega.

takeaway: Achha sawaal poocho, achha jawab pao.
cta: Abhi try karo, comment mein batao
